# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster / Teacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>; Master  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P58](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0058)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is an overbearing instructor who relies on sarcasm and humiliating punishments to discipline his pupils. He is criticized in the community for maintaining poor order in the classroom, ignoring younger students, and focusing his efforts predominantly on older scholars preparing for exams.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley School, lodging at the residence of Eben Duckett during his tenure. While teaching, he spent considerable effort instructing older pupils in subjects such as algebra and preparing them for Regent's entrance examinations while largely neglecting the younger children. During one afternoon, after returning from dinner to find several students late, he sought a victim to enforce discipline and singled out Nell Harcourt. He forced her to sit next to Hugh Carrow as a punishment and made her stand at the front of the room under a humiliating message written on the blackboard. Following this incident, Nell refused to return to his classroom for a period. Local community members, including Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, criticized his ineffective teaching and poor classroom management, noting that he only retained his teaching position because his uncle was a primary school trustee.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P82](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0082), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_
